newsitem.title: USA: CME to delist some less-active options from GLOBEX.
newsitem.headline: CME to delist some less-active options from GLOBEX.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange will delist a handful of less-active currency and equity index options from its GLOBEX electronic trading system, the exchange said Tuesday.
Beginning June 29, all Mexican IPC index options, S&P 500/BARRA Growth and S&P 500/BARRA Value options will be delisted from GLOBEX, the exchange said in memo to members.
Brazilian real options in the third and fourth strikes from at-the-money are also slated for delisting at that time.
The contracts are being dropped due to lack of activity on GLOBEX and to open space for future listings, a CME spokesman said. Their status during regular trading hours is unaffected.
